page.overview:
Who is Planeswalker Saga?

right|thumb|Planeswalkers logo right|thumb|Agents of Artifice with a variation of the logo above

The Planeswalker Saga follows the adventures of the new breed of planeswalkers that emerged after the Mending. These new characters were first introduced with Lorwyn on a dedicated [http://www.wizards.com/Magic/TCG/Article.aspx?x=magic/planeswalkers/home Planeswalkers minisite]. Later on, older planeswalkers that were changed by the Mending followed.

Since then their stories have been told in comics (Path of the Planeswalker), in novels (see A Planeswalker Novel) and in the Magic Story column.

See the complete list of these characters.
